panels.title: Network bandwidth (Rx up / Tx down)
panels.description: Bits per second per interface (loopback excluded). Transmit is drawn below the axis.

panels.title: Packet rate (Rx up / Tx down)
panels.description: Packets per second. Sudden Rx jumps with small packet size can indicate a SYN flood.

panels.title: Interface errors
panels.description: Errors/s. Rx: corrupted frames, cabling/SFP faults, duplex mismatch. Tx: driver/hardware send failures.

panels.title: Interface drops (Rx + Tx)
panels.description: Drops/s. Rx: ring buffer full, CPU can't service interrupts fast enough. Tx: txqueuelen full from saturation or throttling.

targets.expr:
sum by (instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", device!="lo"}[$__rate_interval]))
+
sum by (instance, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{role=~"$role", instance=~"$instance", device!="lo"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average Rx packet size
panels.description: Bytes per received packet.

panels.title: Inbound transport errors
panels.description: TCP: bad checksums/headers. UDP: undeliverable datagrams, including receive-buffer overflows.

panels.title: UDP no-port drops
panels.description: UDP packets/s arriving at a port with no listening socket.

panels.title: UDP receive buffer overflows
panels.description: Socket receive buffer full: the application is reading too slowly.

panels.title: 3. TCP Reliability, Socket Backlogs & Socket States
TCP retransmission %
panels.description: Retransmitted segments as % of outbound segments. Needs node_netstat_Tcp_OutSegs in the Alloy keep rule.

panels.title: SYN retransmits
panels.description: Handshake SYNs retried: path loss or SYN flood.

panels.title: TCP timeouts
panels.description: Retransmission timeouts (RTO) fired per second. Counts timeout events, not closed connections.

panels.title: Listen backlog drops & overflows
panels.description: listen() backlog full. Shown separately because ListenDrops usually already counts overflows; adding them double-counts.

panels.title: TCP sockets by state
panels.description: TIME_WAIT spikes: many short-lived connections (e.g. no keep-alive). Orphans: sockets already closed by the app that peers haven't finished closing; leaked handles show as rising file descriptors instead.

panels.title: Conntrack table saturation
panels.description: Current % of nf_conntrack_max in use. Empty on hosts without the nf_conntrack module.

panels.title: CPU iowait
panels.description: % of CPU time waiting on I/O.

panels.title: CPU time by mode
panels.description: Non-idle modes (user, system, iowait, steal, ...). Steal > a few % means a noisy hypervisor neighbour.

panels.title: Load average vs cores
panels.description: Load above the dashed core count means work is queuing.

panels.title: Processes running / blocked
panels.description: Blocked = uninterruptible sleep (D state), almost always disk or NFS I/O.

panels.title: Swap usage %
panels.description: Hosts with no swap configured are omitted instead of showing NaN.

panels.title: Memory breakdown
panels.description: Low 'free' is normal when 'cached' is high; 'available' is the number that matters.

panels.title: Filesystem usage (now)
panels.description: Virtual filesystems (tmpfs, overlay, squashfs, ...) excluded. Based on avail_bytes: 100% means applications can no longer write.

panels.title: Disk utilization (% busy)
panels.description: % of time the device had I/O in flight. Near 100% on a spinning disk = saturated; SSD, NVMe and RAID can sit near 100% with headroom left.

panels.title: Software RAID (mdadm) failed disks
panels.description: Failed member disks per md array. Green = 0 failed.

panels.title: File descriptor usage %
panels.description: System-wide open handles (files + sockets) vs fs.file-max.

panels.title: NTP time offset
panels.description: Offset from the NTP reference. Negative values are fine; watch magnitude.

panels.title: Clock skew vs scrape time
panels.description: Host clock minus the time Alloy scraped it. Includes a little scrape latency.

panels.title: Host info
panels.description: From node_uname_info.
